overview: This 685-page file documents Japan’s political transition under Allied occupation from 1947 to 1948. It combines election surveillance and results, translated Diet rules and election laws, party platforms, diplomatic conversations, press commentary, and public opinion research. The records also trace disputes over economic reform, political purges, labor, and the future of Japanese democracy.
interest: Election records and opinion surveys reveal how Japanese voters, politicians, and Occupation officials assessed democracy as it took shape.
